bead.title: routing: haiku (low tier) still auto-routed at policy=default despite exact_pin_only — alias gate miss
bead.description: PROBLEM: after v0.14.39 set claude-haiku-5.5 exact_pin_only:true, workers STILL auto-route to model "haiku" at policy=default ("do route claude/haiku score=138.3"). codex tiers (gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.5) and claude opus/sonnet route correctly, so the catalog flag works for canonical IDs. ROOT CAUSE (hypothesis): the subscription-harness tier enrollment emits the ALIAS "haiku" (claude surface alias), and the engine eligibility/exact_pin_only gate (internal/routing/gating.go CheckPowerEligibility -> ModelEligibility lookup) resolves by that alias and does NOT map it to the catalog entry "claude-haiku-5.5" that carries exact_pin_only — so AutoRoutable/ExactPinOnly is missed and haiku passes the gate. Verify the actual tier IDs in catalogTierModelsForHarnessSurface / subprocessHarnessModelIDs vs the catalog key + alias resolution in serviceRoutingModelEligibility. PROPOSED FIX: resolve subscription-harness tier candidate IDs (and the eligibility lookup) to the canonical catalog entry so exact_pin_only/AutoRoutable is honored for aliases (haiku/sonnet/opus). NON-SCOPE: changing which tiers are pin-only (haiku stays pin-only per FEAT-004).
bead.acceptance: 1. New test: an unpinned policy=default ResolveRoute on the claude harness does NOT select the haiku/low tier (selects sonnet/middle); haiku is only reachable via explicit --model pin. 2. Test asserts the eligibility lookup for the claude low-tier alias resolves ExactPinOnly=true. 3. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && go test ./internal/routing/... ./internal/modelcatalog/... . -count=1 green. 4. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
